identity.name: Sindhuli Multiple Campus
identity.short_description: Sindhuli Multiple Campus is a community-owned higher education institution located in Kamalamai, Sindhuli, affiliated with Tribhuvan University.
identity.description: Sindhuli Multiple Campus is one of the premier community-based educational institutions in the Sindhuli district of Bagmati Province, Nepal. Established with the objective of providing accessible quality higher education to the local community, it offers various undergraduate and graduate programs under Tribhuvan University.

location.full_address: Kamalamai-6, Sindhulimadi, Sindhuli, Bagmati Province, Nepal

academics.teaching_methodology: Lectures, practicals, interactive sessions, and assignments.
